card.name: The word as in "as soon as possible"
card.fires_on: The second word "as" in "as soon as possible", mostly in instructions for missed doses, starting treatment, or stopping a drug when pregnancy is detected. Weaker on "immediately" after an administration instruction.

modes.label: Missed dose instructions
modes.description: "as" after "as soon" in directions on what to do when a dose is missed.
modes.example: If a weekly dose is missed, administer the dose as soon<< as>> possible, and start a new weekly schedule
